the same stale-value class recurred independently in PR #426's own diff (grounding_aware_candidate_supply_regression.yml and a fourth occurrence in that workflow), confirming this was not a one-off typo but a systemic drift pattern across several independently-maintained CI assertions of the same hotfix-mutated constant

root_cause.summary: MAX_TOPIC_REGENERATIONS is not statically defined in checked-in source; ci_hotfix.py rewrites it from an earlier value to 19 at CI runtime. Multiple independent CI assertions across different files hard-coded the pre-rewrite literal '= 6' and were never updated when the production value changed, so they failed against genuinely correct production code -- exactly the drift pattern AGENTS.md's Quality section now warns against.

evidence.note: commit message documents re-deriving the correct value by running ci_hotfix.py in a clean worktree and re-reading main.py, rather than trusting a remembered number.
